podcast.title: Hit Prediction for "I'll Take You There"
podcast.body: Teresa Davis, a member of The Emotions, heard The Staples Singers recording "I'll Take You There" and immediately recognized its hit potential, exclaiming, "that's a hit." "Teresa Davis of the Emotions, which would have a number one song in 1978 with the best of my love, heard the Staples singers recording. I'll take you there and said, that's a hit."
